$comment: Fixture 28 with a 28C256 in place of the 28C16: a dip switch drives A0, A1 and A2, A3 to A14 are on GND, /OE and /CE are low and /WE is high, and each data pin has 10 kohm to GND.
The image is the eight bytes 00 11 22 33 44 55 66 77 (contents ABEiM0RVZnc=), so the word at address k is 0x11 * k: the data pins read the bits of k * 17.

A 28C256's pull-downs take the lines to 0 V for a 0 bit and the chip drives 5 V (its HIGH level) for a 1 bit. Eight phases of 1 ms read addresses 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 in that order (the dip switch positions are the phases' sets).
test/core/promoted-kinds-fixtures.test.ts reads the eight words on both engines.
